recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the specific Published request without broadening the change to other Claim-family artifacts that were not part of FHIR-19461.
issue_request: FHIR-19461 is a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request for STU3 Claim asking to change the binding name on Claim.diagnosis.diagnosis from ICD10 to ICD10-example because the old name made the sample ICD-10 value set look complete.
initial_application: The 2018 broad Claim application commit afb5ec66f6 listed FHIR-19461, but inspection showed it changed the wording to "Example ICD10 Diagnostic codes" while leaving the binding name itself as ICD10. The 2021 spreadsheet-to-StructureDefinition refactor preserved that remaining ICD10 bindingName in source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml a current build input. The binding already had example strength and points at the sample ICD-10 value set; later binding-strength work such as FHIR-53057 did not alter this diagnosis binding name. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision superseding the requested rename.
reconciliation: Changed only the elementdefinition-bindingName extension on Claim.diagnosis.diagnosis[x] from ICD10 to ICD10-example, leaving the existing example strength, description, and ValueSet URL unchanged.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: changed Claim.diagnosis.diagnosis[x] elementdefinition-bindingName from ICD10 to ICD10-example.

related_jiras.note: Later Claim binding-strength cleanup touched nearby bindings but not Claim.diagnosis.diagnosis, so it does not supersede this binding-name fix.
